description: Example dashboard for the wilsonwaters-webview-app plugin. Panel 1 shows Direct mode. Panel 2 shows Proxy mode, which renders in-panel once an admin allowlists the target domain on the app's Configuration page.

options.content:
# Web View plugin — example dashboard

- **Direct mode** (left) renders an external page straight inside the panel; no backend or allowlist needed.
- **Proxy mode** (right) fetches the page through the backend proxy and renders it inside the panel in an isolated frame. It requires an administrator to **allowlist the target domain first** on the app's Configuration page (the allowlist is empty/deny-all by default). Until then the panel shows an HTTP 403 "target host is not allowlisted" message.

See `docs/examples/README.md` and `docs/administration.md` for the allowlist prerequisite.

panels.title: Direct mode — renders in-panel
panels.description: A framable URL loaded with loadMode 'direct'. This panel renders the external page directly inside the panel and needs no backend or allowlist.

panels.title: Proxy mode — requires allowlisting
panels.description: A URL loaded with loadMode 'proxy'. An administrator must allowlist example.org on the app's Configuration page before the proxy will serve it (the allowlist is deny-all by default). Once allowlisted, the page renders inside the panel in a sandboxed frame.
